title: Integer to English Words
summary: Transform a non-negative integer into its corresponding English word form.
statement: Transform a non-negative integer into its corresponding English word form.
constraints: num is an integer from 0 through 2^31-1.
Return its US English words with single spaces and title-case number words. Do not use 'and' or hyphens; zero is exactly 'Zero'.
hints: Process the number in three-digit groups because scale words change at thousand, million, and billion.
Write a helper for one group: optional hundreds, then either a value below 20 or a tens word plus ones.
From billion down through units, divide out each group; spell nonzero groups and append their scale name.
Skip zero groups completely so no extra scale word or space appears. Handle zero before the loop.
editorial: English number names repeat the same grammar within each three-digit group. A helper spells hundreds, teens, tens, and ones. The outer loop extracts billion, million, thousand, and unit groups from left to right, omitting empty groups and joining tokens once. The independent oracle recursively selects the largest applicable scale and spells the quotient and remainder, rather than iterating fixed chunks.
